title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Devin White (healthy scratch) inactive against Panthers
items.desc: Devin White (healthy scratch) is inactive for the Lions game against the Panthers.
items.impact: White used to be a tackling machine, but has struggled to find the field over the last few years. He has had limited snaps for Detroit over the first two weeks, but will now be inactive for the second straight week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) inactive on Sunday against Lions
items.desc: Jalen Coker (quad) is inactive for the Panthers game against the Lions on Sunday night.
items.impact: With Coker out due to his quad injury, Tetairoa McMillan and Darren Waller will operate as the primary one-two for the Carolina passing game. Brycen Tremayne is a sneaky flex start as he will operate as the Panthers WR2.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Bills D/ST allows 29 points in Week 4 loss
items.desc: The Bills D/ST allowed 269 passing yards, 143 rushing yards, and 29 points in the loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: The Bills' defense tallied one sack, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the loss Sunday. Despite the two turnovers, the Bills could not stop a late comeback by Drake Maye in the Patriots. The Bills will travel to Los Angeles to take on the Rams in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyler Bass perfect in Week 4
items.desc: Tyler Bass connected on both of his field goal attempts and both extra point attempts in the loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Bass connected on field goal attempts of 27 and 38 yard field goals in the loss to New England. Bass is 6-for-6 on field goal attempts and has missed on extra point so far this season. Bass and the Bills will head on the road to take on the Rams in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Dalton Kincaid quiet in Week 4
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid caught 1-of-2 targets for seven yards in the loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Kincaid set new season lows in all receiving metrics in the loss Sunday. Fantasy managers will hope that Kincaid bounces back in a Week 5 matchup against the Rams.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Keon Coleman hauls in a touchdown in Week 4
items.desc: Keon Coleman caught 6-of-7 targets for 116 yards and a touchdown in the loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Coleman found the end zone for the first time this season on a 34-yard touchdown reception in the fourth quarter. Coleman set a new season high in yardage and targets in the loss Sunday. Fantasy managers could see Coleman become a bigger part of the offense heading into Week 5 after this performance.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Khalil Shakir hauls in seven passes in Week 4
items.desc: Khalil Shakir caught 7-of-8 targets for 82 yards in the Bills loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Shakir led the team in receptions and targets in the loss Sunday. All three marks are new season highs for Shakir, a potential positive sign for fantasy managers that have rostered him in a tough season. Shakir and the Bills will take on the Rams in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ty Johnson sees three touches in Week 4
items.desc: Ty Johnson rushed for three yards on one carry in the loss to the Patriots. He caught both of his targets for nine yards.
items.impact: Johnson continues to operate as the change of pace back, but has limited fantasy value right now. Fantasy managers can leave Johnson on the waiver wire heading into a matchup with the Rams.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: James Cook III finds the end zone in Week 4
items.desc: James Cook III rushed for 75 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in the loss to the Patriots. He caught both of his targets for eight yards.
items.impact: Cook averaged 6.3 yards per carry on his 12 carries, providing the Bills with an incredibly efficient effort. Despite the strong performance, his 12 rushing attempts are a new season low. Cook and the Bills will take on the Rams in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Josh Allen accounts for two touchdowns in Week 4 loss
items.desc: Josh Allen completed 23-of-33 passes for 254 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the loss to the Patriots. He rushed for four yards and a touchdown on five carries.
items.impact: Allen turned in a solid day Sunday, including a touchdown pass to Keon Coleman late in the game. Allen was without DJ Moore, who left the game in the first half with a shoulder injury. His interception late in the game ended up a comeback and handed the Bills their first loss of the season. Allen and the Bills will travel to Los Angeles to take on the Rams in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Patriots D/ST allows 26 points in Week 4 win
items.desc: The Patriots D/ST allowed 253 passing yards, 91 rushing yards, and 26 points in a win over the Bills.
items.impact: The Patriots' defense tallied one sack, one fumble recovery, and one interception in the win Sunday. The interception was on the final drive for the Bills, helping the Patriots seal their second win of the season. The Patriots will take on the Raiders in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Andy Borregales perfect in Week 4 win
items.desc: Andy Borregales made all three of his extra point attempts in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Borregales was not called upon to attempt any field goals in the win Sunday. The second-year kicker is 5-for-7 on field goal attempts and 6-for-6 on extra point attempts so far this season.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Hunter Henry hauls in five passes in Week 4 win
items.desc: Hunter Henry caught all five of his targets for 62 yards in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Henry led the team in receiving yards, and caught the pass to seal the win late in the fourth quarter. His five receptions and 62 yards mark new season highs for the veteran. Henry will look to build on this performance against the Raiders in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Efton Chism III finds the end zone in Week 4 win
items.desc: Efton Chism III caught 2-of-4 targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Chism made an impressive 23-yard touchdown reception late in the fourth quarter to give the Patriots the lead and the win Sunday. His two receptions and 42 yards establish new season highs, but Chism could be asked to do more in Week 5 if Mack Hollins (calf) is unable to suit up against Las Vegas.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: DeMario Douglas held to two receptions in Week 4
items.desc: DeMario Douglas caught 2-of-3 targets for 15 yards in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Douglas continues to see limited targets in the Patriots' offense. Fantasy managers should feel comfortable leaving him on the waiver wire heading into Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mack Hollins hauls in three passes in Week 4 win
items.desc: Mack Hollins caught 3-of-4 targets for 53 yards in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Hollins continues to excel in his role as a chain mover, but the veteran did exit the game with a calf injury. Fantasy managers will want to monitor his status heading into a Week 5 matchup with the Raiders.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Romeo Doubs hauls in two touchdowns in Week 4 win
items.desc: Romeo Doubs caught 6-of-9 targets for 58 yards and two touchdowns in the Patriots win over the Bills.
items.impact: Doubs caught passes of two and 14 yards to account for two of Drake Maye's three touchdown passes on the day. This was easily Doubs' best day as a Patriot. Fantasy managers should expect Doubs to continue to see plenty of targets heading into a Week 5 matchup with Las Vegas.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson sees 14 touches in Week 4 win
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson rushed for 42 yards on 14 carries in the Patriots win over the Bills. He did not record a reception on his two targets.
items.impact: Henderson saw just one more carry that Rhamondre Stevenson, but failed to do much on his 14 touches. Fantasy managers should expect Stevenson and Henderson to continue to split time in the backfield in Week 5 against Las Vegas.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson sees 16 touches in Week 4 win
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed for 47 yards and a touchdown on 13 carries in the Patriots win over the Bills. He caught 3-of-5 targets for 27 yards.
items.impact: Stevenson found the end zone on a one-yard plunge in the second-quarter. Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson split time in the backfield, and fantasy managers should expect more of the same against the Raiders in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Drake Maye tosses three touchdowns in Week 4 win
items.desc: Drake Maye completed 22-of-37 passes for 269 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in the win over the Bills. He added 54 rushing yards on eight carries, while losing one fumble.
items.impact: Maye led the Patriots to a comeback win on the road against the Bills, despite struggling again with some turnovers. The former first-round pick was able to find Efton Chism on a 23-yard pass to give the team the lead with under two minutes remaining. He will look to build on this performance against the Raiders in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ravens D/ST allows 18 points in Week 4 win
items.desc: The Ravens D/ST allowed 222 passing yards, 85 rushing yards, and 18 points in a win over the Titans.
items.impact: The Ravens' defense tallied one, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the win. The Titans' offense was finally able to start breaking through in the second half, but the game appeared well in hand at that point. The Ravens will travel to Atlanta in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyler Loop makes 64-yard field goal in Week 4 win
items.desc: Tyler Loop made 1-of-2 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in the Ravens win over the Titans.
items.impact: Loop connected on a 64-yard field goal attempt to close out the first half. He would later miss a 40-yard attempt late in the fourth quarter. Loop is 6-for-8 so far on field goal attempts this season.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mark Andrews finds the end zone in Week 4 win
items.desc: Mark Andrews caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens win over the Titans.
items.impact: Andrews caught a three-yard touchdown pass late in the second quarter to extend the Ravens' lead. This marked the veteran's first trip to the end zone this season. Andrews will look to build on this performance against the Falcons in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rashod Bateman held to two receptions in Week 4
items.desc: Rashod Bateman caught 2-of-2 targets for 46 yards in the Ravens win over the Titans.
items.impact: Bateman has not been able to replicate his Week 2 success with Zay Flowers in the lineup. Fantasy managers should view Bateman as a risky option heading into a Week 5 matchup with the Falcons.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Zay Flowers eclipses 100 receiving yards in Week 4
items.desc: Zay Flowers caught 8-of-10 targets for 118 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens win over the Titans.
items.impact: Flowers found the end zone on a 19-yard touchdown pass from Lamar Jackson early in the second quarter. Flowers has recorded a touchdown in two of the three games he's played this season. He will look to continue his early season momentum against the Falcons in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Derrick Henry finds the end zone in Week 4 win
items.desc: Derrick Henry rushed for 73 yards and a touchdown on 23 carries in the Ravens win over the Titans. He caught both of his targets for six yards.
items.impact: Henry opened the scoring with a five-yard plunge into the end zone in the first quarter. The veteran running back has found the end zone at least once in each of the team's first four games. Fantasy managers should expect Henry to remain a key factor for the Ravens heading into a Week 5 matchup in Atlanta.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyler Huntley sold in relief in Week 4 win
items.desc: Tyler Huntley completed 8-of-9 passes for 63 yards in the Ravens' 24-18 win over the Titans. He added 16 rushing yards on four attempts.
items.impact: Huntley entered the game after the half with Lamar Jackson dealing with an ankle injury. Although the Ravens appear optimistic about Jackson's ankle injury, Huntley would be in line to start against the Falcons should Jackson be forced to miss time.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Titans D/ST allows 24 points in Week 4 loss
items.desc: The Titans D/ST allowed 24 points, 272 rushing yards, and 112 rushing yards in a loss to the Ravens in Week 5.
items.impact: The Titans' defense tallied two sacks, including one that injured Lamar Jackson (ankle) and kept him from returning to the game. The Titans will take on the Texans in Week 5, with both teams searching for their first win of the season.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Joey Slye perfect in Week 4
items.desc: Joey Slye connected on his lone field goal and lone extra point attempt in the loss to the Ravens.
items.impact: Slye made his lone field goal attempt on a 33-yard kick in the third quarter. The 30-year-old need a bounce back performance after missing his lone field goal attempt last week. Slye and the Titans will take on Houston in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Elic Ayomanor held to one reception in Week 4
items.desc: Elic Ayomanor caught his lone target for 22 yards in the Titans loss to the Ravens.
items.impact: Ayomanor continues to see a limited target share in his second season in the NFL. The 23-year-old would likely need an injury to Carnell Tate or Wan'Dale Robinson to become an option for fantasy managers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Wan'Dale Robinson hauls in three passes in Week 4
items.desc: Wan'Dale Robinson caught 3-of-5 targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in the Titans loss to the Ravens.
items.impact: Robinson caught the lone touchdown pass from Cam Ward against the Ravens, giving Robinson a touchdown in back-to-back games. The 25-year-old will look to continue that streak in Week 5 against the Texans.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Carnell Tate eclipses 100 receiving yards in Week 4 loss
items.desc: Carnell Tate caught 9-of-12 targets for 145 yards in the Titans loss to the Ravens Sunday .
items.impact: Tate did fumble the ball twice, losing one after an impressive reception. He set new season highs in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in the loss. Tate and the Titans will look for their first win of the season as they take on Houston in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyjae Spears sees three touches in Week 4 loss
items.desc: Tyjae Spears rushed for seven yards on two carries in the Titans loss to the Ravens. He caught his lone target for a loss of a yard.
items.impact: Spears continues to mange an ankle injury, but continues to see limited rushing attempts by Tony Pollard. With just 15 rushing attempts this season, he is a handcuff at best heading into Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tony Pollard finds the end zone in Week 4 loss
items.desc: Tony Pollard rushed for 48 yards and a touchdown on 16 carries in the Titans' loss to the Ravens. Pollard caught 2-of-4 targets for two yards.
items.impact: Pollard entered the game as the favorite to see the bulk of the carries for the Titans, with Tyjae Spears receiving just two carries. Pollard continues to see plenty of carries, but has not been able to do much yardage wise this season. Pollard and the Titans will take on the Texans in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Cam Ward tosses one touchdown in Week 4 loss
items.desc: Cam Ward completed 20-of-31 passes for 222 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a loss to the Ravens. He added 27 rushing yards on four carries.
items.impact: Ward turned in his best overall performance of the season, but it was not enough to keep the Titans out of the loss column. The Titans will take on the Texans in Week 5, in a matchup where both teams will be looking for their first win of the season.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring) questionable to return
items.desc: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice is questionable to return against the Raiders with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Rice suffered the injury after a reception and hobbled off the field. Fantasy managers should expect the team to provide an update after halftime.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is considered day-to-day with an ankle injury.
items.impact: Jackson was listed as questionable to return Sunday, but he remained on the sideline for the rest of the game. Jackson was seen exiting the stadium in a boot, but head coach Jesse Minter appeared to be optimistic about Jackson's prognosis. The Ravens take on the Falcons in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tee Higgins suffers adductor injury Sunday
items.desc: Bengals WR Tee Higgins suffered an adductor injury late in Sunday's loss to Jacksonville.
items.impact: Higgins had an excellent day against Jacksonville, but suffered the injury late and was unable to go back into the game. Fantasy managers will want to monitor his status ahead of a Week 5 matchup with Miami.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Edgerrin Cooper feared to have torn Achilles
items.desc: The Packers fear that LB Edgerrin Cooper suffered a torn Achilles Sunday.
items.impact: Cooper will likely undergo tests Monday to confirm the injury, but considering the initial concern, it appears the Packers will play without Cooper for the remainder of the season. Cooper was off to an excellent start to the season, tallying three sacks and an interception over the first four games. This will be a major blow to the Packers' defense for the remainder of the season.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Commanders D/ST allows 30 points in Week 4 loss
items.desc: The Commanders D/ST allowed 143 passing yards, 128 rushing yards, and 30 points in a loss to the Colts.
items.impact: The Commanders' defense tallied two sacks, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the loss. Despite a solid showing from the defense, the Commanders' offense struggled to get anything going. The Commanders will travel to Pittsburgh in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Drew Stevens perfect in Week 4
items.desc: Drew Stevens made both of his field goal attempts and his lone extra point attempt in a loss to the Colts.
items.impact: Stevens opened the scoring in the first quarter with field goals from 29 and 31 yards out. Stevens is perfect on field goal attempts the last two weeks, which was much needed after going 3-for-5 in the first two weeks of the season. Stevens and the Commanders will take on the Giants in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Treylon Burks finds the end zone in Week 4
items.desc: Treylon Burks caught 1-of-3 targets for 47 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders loss to the Colts.
items.impact: Burks caught the first touchdown of rookie QB Athan Kaliakmanis' career, the lone touchdown for the Commanders' offense Sunday. Fantasy managers should still view Burks as an option only in deeper leagues.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Antonio Williams hauls in three passes in Week 4
items.desc: Antonio Williams caught 3-of-8 targets for 21 yards in the Commanders loss to the Colts.
items.impact: Williams was second on the team in targets, just one behind Stefon Diggs. Williams could continue to see more playing time next week if Terry McLaurin does not return from his hamstring injury.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Stefon Diggs hauls in five passes in Week 4
items.desc: Stefon Diggs caught 5-of-9 targets for 35 yards in the Commanders loss to the Colts in London.
items.impact: Diggs led the team in targets and receptions in the loss Sunday. If Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is unable to play, Diggs could serve as the WR1 for the Commanders against the Giants next week. Fantasy managers will want to monitor the situation, as the quarterback could be rookie Athan Kaliakmanis if Jayden Daniels (elbow) does not return.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt  quiet in Week 4 loss
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt rushed for 15 yards on nine carries in the Commanders loss to the Colts. He caught 2-of-4 passes for 35 yards.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt and the entire Commanders' rushing attack struggled to get anything going against the Colts. With the current quarterback situation in Washington, Croskey-Merritt and the rest of the running backs could be asked to see more work in a Week 5 matchup with the Giants.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Athan Kaliakmanis forced into action in Week 4
items.desc: Athan Kaliakmanis completed 15-of-33 passes for 186 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a loss to the Colts. He added 16 rushing yards on three carries.
items.impact: The former seventh-round draft pick entered the game once Marcus Mariota was forced out of the game with a knee injury. He threw his first NFL touchdown pass to Treylon Burks in the third quarter. Marcus Mariota will likely undergo further testing, but Kaliakmanis could be in line for a Week 5 start if Jayden Daniels (elbow) is not cleared to return.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Colts D/ST allows 13 points in Week 4 win
items.desc: The Colts D/ST allowed 217 passing yards, 100 rushing yards, and 13 points in a win over the Commanders Sunday.
items.impact: The Colts' defense tallied two sacks and one interception in the win. The team faced an easier matchup once the Commanders were forced to turn to Athan Kaliakmanis with Marcus Mariota suffering a knee injury early. The Colts will take on the Steelers in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Spencer Shrader makes three field goals in Week 4 win
items.desc: Spencer Shrader made 3-of-3 field goals and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in the Colts' 30-13 win over the Commanders.
items.impact: Shrader made field goals from 44, 48, and 52 yards out to help pace the Colts to the win in London. The 27-year-old has not missed a field goal attempt this season and will look to continue his strong season against the Steelers in Week 5.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyler Warren hauls in five passes in Week 4 win
items.desc: Tyler Warren caught 5-of-5 targets for 41 yards in the Colts' 30-13 win over the Commanders.
items.impact: Warren and the rest of the Colts' pass catchers had a relatively quiet day as the team focused on the ground game. His five targets tie a season low, and Warren will look to become more involved in Week 5 against the Steelers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Laquon Treadwell hauls in five passes in Week 4 win
items.desc: Laquon Treadwell caught 5-of-6 targets for 42 yards in the Colts win over the Commanders.
items.impact: Treadwell saw an increase in playing time with the Colts dealing with injuries to Alec Pierce and Keenan Allen. Fantasy managers should expect this to be an outlier, as Treadwell's playing time will diminish once Allen and Pierce return.
